lab_command_option_disabled.description: An actinglab offline package-tool command (recording, binding draft, package check, resource catalog and the like) ran while Lab option one (authoring) is not installed. It prints one JSON line, exits 1 and changes no file. actinglab reads the two options from the Runtime's configuration facts, or from the selected configuration generation when the Runtime does not answer; until #389 U-6, a configuration that names neither option counts as both installed.
lab_command_option_disabled.common_causes: Only the debugging option is installed.
lab_command_option_disabled.handling: Tick the authoring option on the installer's Lab page.

observe_identity_limit_exceeded.description: actinglab observe (offline or with --capture) printed its default Min output, and after omitting every fact row and every projection entry the output still exceeds the Min hard byte limit: the identity left (the observation identity, its source and the other members Min keeps, such as candidate sets) does not fit. It answers no result and exits 2; with --capture the Runtime has already recorded the observation. When omitting entries is enough, observe answers the identity marked truncated with its omitted counts instead (#391 MCP-391b).
observe_identity_limit_exceeded.common_causes: A package whose candidate layouts project large candidate sets on the observed page.
observe_identity_limit_exceeded.handling: Ask for the Normal view with --verbose (MCP: verbose true).

replay_run_refused.description: actinglab replay --frames replayed the whole package over the frame sequence and the replayed run did not complete. The details carry the replay (entry check, steps, recognitions) and, as end.outcome, the outcome the run ended with; offline_fixture_exhausted when the run needed a frame after the last one of the sequence. Nothing was executed; the exit code is that of a usage refusal, so a CI job fails on it.
replay_run_refused.common_causes: The package no longer recognizes a recorded page or guard; the sequence ends before the run does; a select step chose nothing with the given facts.
replay_run_refused.handling: Read end.outcome and the last step of the details; fix the package or record a sequence that reaches the run's end.

replay_frames_unreadable.description: actinglab replay --frames could not list the --frames directory or one of its entries.
replay_frames_unreadable.common_causes: The path does not exist, is not a directory, or is not readable.
replay_frames_unreadable.handling: Name a readable directory of PNG frames.

replay_frames_invalid.description: The --frames directory of actinglab replay holds an entry that is not a PNG file (a subdirectory, a link or a file without the .png extension). Every entry of the directory is a frame, replayed in file-name order.
replay_frames_invalid.common_causes: Other files were saved beside the frames.
replay_frames_invalid.handling: Keep only the PNG frames in the directory.

replay_facts_unreadable.description: actinglab replay could not open or read the --facts file.
replay_facts_unreadable.common_causes: The path does not exist or is not readable.

replay_facts_invalid.description: The --facts file of actinglab replay is not one complete instance fact answer of a Runtime: the result of actingctl facts --instance or of MCP ac_facts with scope instance (scope, read_at_unix_ms, snapshot, records_total, records_kept), read without key_prefix so that it holds every record, with a valid snapshot, within 4 MiB.
replay_facts_invalid.common_causes: The answer was read with --key-prefix, is of another scope, or was edited.
replay_facts_invalid.handling: Read the instance's facts again without a key prefix and save the answer unchanged.

replay_scan_refused.description: actinglab replay --frames --select --scan replayed the scan of the select step over the frame sequence through the kernel's scan path, and the scan did not cover its list. Either the selection evaluator ended it before its coverage (end.status aborted, end.coverage not_started or incomplete, the decision in scan.decision) or it failed (end.status failed, the outcome in end.outcome; selection_scan_replay_frame_missing when it needed a frame the sequence does not hold, such as a corrective, a rewind or a capture after the last frame). Nothing was executed; the exit code is that of a usage refusal, so a CI job fails on it.
replay_scan_refused.common_causes: The pack no longer finds or reads the recorded list; the recording is not a forward run from the list's start to its end; a declared fact list is missing from the given facts.
replay_scan_refused.handling: Read end and the scan's viewports in the details; fix the pack or the scan declaration, or record a forward run that reaches the list's end.

replay_scan_unreadable.description: actinglab replay could not open or read the --scan file.
replay_scan_unreadable.common_causes: The path does not exist or is not readable.

replay_scan_invalid.description: The --scan file of actinglab replay is not one scan declaration of a select step (selector model S0 v2.1 section 2.1: every member, no unknown member), within 1 MiB.
replay_scan_invalid.common_causes: A member is missing, misspelt or of the wrong type, or the file holds more than the declaration.
replay_scan_invalid.handling: Save the step's scan declaration alone, with every member it requires.

recognition_regression_evidence_unreadab.description: actinglab recognition-regression could not open or read an --evidence file.
recognition_regression_evidence_unreadab.common_causes: The path does not exist or is not readable.
recognition_regression_evidence_unreadab.handling: Name a readable file: the saved answer of actingctl run evidence or ac_run_evidence.

recognition_regression_evidence_invalid.description: An --evidence file of actinglab recognition-regression is not one page of a run's evidence as actingctl run evidence or ac_run_evidence answer it (request_id, and steps with step_index and frames[].ref), within 16 MiB; or two pages are of different runs; or the pages name no frame.
recognition_regression_evidence_invalid.common_causes: The answer was edited or truncated, pages of two runs were given, or the run kept no frame.
recognition_regression_evidence_invalid.handling: Save the run's evidence pages unchanged, all of one run, and name a run whose frames were kept.

recognition_regression_ledger_unreadable.description: actinglab recognition-regression could not read the ledger of --state-root: it does not open, it is incomplete or corrupt, an artifact does not verify, or the run's events cannot be read. Nothing was compared.
recognition_regression_ledger_unreadable.common_causes: The path is not a Runtime state root, or its ledger is damaged.
recognition_regression_ledger_unreadable.handling: Name the state root of the Runtime that recorded the run; run the ledger checks if it is damaged.

recognition_regression_frame_unknown.description: A frame reference of the --evidence of actinglab recognition-regression names no verified capture frame of the run in the ledger of --state-root. Nothing was compared.
recognition_regression_frame_unknown.common_causes: The evidence was read from another Runtime than --state-root names, or was edited.
recognition_regression_frame_unknown.handling: Read the evidence from the Runtime whose state root is given, and save it unchanged.

recognition_regression_frame_invalid.description: A frame that the evidence of actinglab recognition-regression references is not a PNG image, or its material does not read for another reason than its absence, or its PNG does not decode. Nothing was compared. A frame whose material is gone is not this error: it is listed as material_missing.
recognition_regression_frame_invalid.common_causes: The frame's material was replaced or damaged.
recognition_regression_frame_invalid.handling: Check the state root's artifact store; replay another run.

package_fmt_check_failed.description: actinglab package fmt --check read a content directory and found JSON files that are not in the canonical serialization (two-space indentation, one member or element per line, members in their document order, UTF-8 text, LF line endings including the last line, no byte-order mark). The details list them as unformatted. Nothing was written; the command exits 2 (Workflow #390 TOOL-1).
package_fmt_check_failed.common_causes: A JSON file of the package was written or edited by another tool, or by hand.
package_fmt_check_failed.handling: Run actinglab package fmt on the directory without --check and commit the result.

package_fmt_write_failed.description: actinglab package fmt could not write a reformatted JSON file over the old one (written to a .part file beside it, then renamed over it). The details name the file it stopped at, the files already written and any .part file left behind; nothing is removed (Workflow #390 TOOL-1).
package_fmt_write_failed.common_causes: The file is open in another program, or the directory is read-only.
package_fmt_write_failed.handling: Close the program holding the file, remove a .part file left behind, and run package fmt again.

package_edit_patch_invalid.description: The edits given to actinglab package edit are not an edit list: the --patch file is unreadable, larger than 32 MiB or not a JSON array of {file, op, path, value} objects with op add or replace; or --value is not one JSON value; or an edit names a file the content directory does not hold or that is not a JSON file, or its path is not a JSON pointer (RFC 6901). The details name the edit by its index. Nothing was written (Workflow #390 TOOL-1).
package_edit_patch_invalid.common_causes: A misspelt member or operation, a Windows path in place of the package path, or an unescaped ~ or / in a pointer token.
package_edit_patch_invalid.handling: Write the edits as a JSON array of {file, op, path, value}, file a path inside the package and path a JSON pointer.

package_edit_pointer_unresolved.description: An edit of actinglab package edit names a place its operation cannot take: replace names a member or element the file does not hold, add names a parent that does not exist or is not an object or array, or an array index past the end (an index equal to the length, or -, appends). The details name the edit by its index, its file and its pointer. Nothing was written (Workflow #390 TOOL-1).
package_edit_pointer_unresolved.common_causes: A misspelt member in the pointer, an index counted from 1, or an edit that depends on a later one.
package_edit_pointer_unresolved.handling: Read the file and correct the pointer; order the edits so a parent is added before its members.

package_edit_admission_refused.description: actinglab package edit applied its edits in memory, and the edited content directory fails the structural admission actingd makes of a content directory. The details carry the admission's code, its detail and, for a refused declaration, the declaration's file, JSON pointer and reason. Nothing was written (Workflow #390 TOOL-1).
package_edit_admission_refused.common_causes: An edit that leaves an unknown member, a wrong type, a reference to a page or target the package does not declare, or a control that no longer matches its task.
package_edit_admission_refused.handling: Correct the edits, or add the edits that keep the package consistent to the same edit list.

package_edit_write_failed.description: actinglab package edit admitted the edited package and could not write an edited file over the old one (written to a .part file beside it, then renamed over it). The details name the file it stopped at, the files already written and any .part file left behind; nothing is removed (Workflow #390 TOOL-1).
package_edit_write_failed.common_causes: The file is open in another program, or the directory is read-only.
package_edit_write_failed.handling: Close the program holding the file, remove a .part file left behind, and run the same edits again on the package as it now is.

lab_frame_export_failed.description: actinglab observe --preview, or do after an action it performed, could not export a frame (Workflow #410 item 1): reading the Runtime's verified frame, encoding its JPEG preview or writing the frame or the preview into the Lab frame directory (%LOCALAPPDATA%\ActingCommand\actinglab\frames) failed. The answer still succeeds, and with do the action was performed: the part not written (preview, or after_attachment.frame_path or .preview) is answered as failure {code, path, raw_text} in its place, with the path it was written to when one was known and the operating system's text as raw_text. No image is put into the answer instead.
lab_frame_export_failed.common_causes: LOCALAPPDATA is not set; the disk is full or the folder is not writable; the Runtime's frame was removed from its artifact store.
lab_frame_export_failed.handling: Free or fix the Lab frame directory and observe again (with preview), or read the frame with ac_material.

resource_pool_producer_missing.description: actinglab resource validate read a scheduling pools document whose ledger_fact pool nothing in the repository publishes (Workflow #390 nine6, item 6 of the nine additions of 2026-10-10): no reading mark (as fact_key or capacity_fact_key) and no adjustment of any operation task.json outside the excluded material writes the pool's fact key, or the pool is of server or game scope while readings and adjustments write instance facts only. Such a pool never gets a value, so a task its predicate gates waits for a fact refresh no package answers. It is a warning: the document is still valid and the command still succeeds; the answer lists it under warnings with the document's path, the pool's JSON pointer and its fact key. A static_snapshot pool takes its value from the configuration's resources and is not checked.
resource_pool_producer_missing.common_causes: The pool was made live (ledger_fact) before a package declared a reading of its key; the reading's fact_key is spelled differently from the pool's; the package with the reading was removed or moved into archived material; the pool was declared with a server or game scope.
resource_pool_producer_missing.handling: Add a reading mark or an adjustment of the key to a package of the repository, correct the key or the pool's scope, or keep the pool a static snapshot.
